body: Commits fc95683/ce5fa14 on main. Real bug found: draw_char's digit branch drew the exact same generic box outline for every single digit 0-9, indistinguishable from each other. Every numeric HUD value this game shows (HP/MP, ability cooldown countdown, Flow/XP/item costs, K/D, APM) has been effectively illegible as a specific number all session. Replaced with a real standard 7-segment mapping, same GL_LINES stroke style as every other glyph in this font. Build clean, full suite green. Live Xvfb confirms the rendering pipeline is healthy (letters render correctly); couldn't capture an active on-screen number in this sandbox (no interactive input available, no cooldowns active at match start) -- the segment mapping is a standard, directly-verifiable table, not a guess.
title: Real 7-segment digit glyphs -- every number was illegible (S170-185)
